# API reference

Generated from the source of `github.com/otfabric/go-canbus` with `docsync api`; the doc comments are the documentation. The guides around it explain how the pieces fit.

| Package | Synopsis |
|---|---|
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus](go-canbus.md) | Package canbus is the transport-neutral core of go-canbus: CAN and CAN FD frames, identifiers, data length codes, filters, error frames, the Transport interface and the Bus, which shares one transport among many subscribers. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/arxml](arxml.md) | Package arxml reads the CAN part of AUTOSAR 4.x system descriptions (ARXML) into the format-independent model of package candb. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/candb](candb.md) | Package candb is the format-independent model of a CAN message database and its signal codec. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/candb/bits](candb-bits.md) | Package bits extracts and inserts bit fields of CAN payloads in the two layouts of CAN databases. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/capture](capture.md) | Package capture reads and writes CAN traces and replays them. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/chaos](chaos.md) | Package chaos injects faults between two CAN transports. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/codegen](codegen.md) | Package codegen generates Go code from a candb.Database: one struct per message with typed raw fields, identifier and length constants, enum types for value descriptions, physical-value accessors, and multiplexer-aware Encode, Decode and Frame methods. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/dbc](dbc.md) | Package dbc reads and writes DBC files into the format-independent model of package candb. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/isotp](isotp.md) | Package isotp implements ISO 15765-2 (ISO-TP), the transport protocol that carries messages of up to 4095 bytes (or 4 GiB with the escape sequence) over CAN frames, in userspace on top of a canbus.Bus. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/kcd](kcd.md) | Package kcd reads KCD files, the XML CAN database format of the Kayak project (namespace http://kayak.2codeornot2code.org/1.0), into the format-independent model of package candb. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/slcan](slcan.md) | Package slcan is a CAN transport over the serial-line CAN protocol (LAWICEL ASCII, "slcan") of USB-to-CAN adapters such as the CANable, CANtact, USBtin and LAWICEL CANUSB, without the Linux slcan driver: it works on every operating system go-serial supports and over any byte stream (a pseudo-terminal, a TCP connection to a serial server). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/socketcan](socketcan.md) | Package socketcan is the Linux SocketCAN transport: CAN_RAW sockets with CAN FD, kernel filters, error frames, loopback control, kernel timestamps and drop accounting, and kernel ISO-TP sockets (CAN_ISOTP). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/socketcan/link](socketcan-link.md) | Package link reads and changes the configuration of Linux CAN network interfaces through rtnetlink, the interface ip-link(8) uses: listing CAN interfaces, their state, bit timing, CAN FD data bit timing, control modes, error counters and statistics; bringing them up and down; setting bit rates, CAN FD mode, restart-ms and MTU; restarting a bus-off controller; creating and deleting vcan and vxcan interfaces. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/virtual](virtual.md) | Package virtual is a deterministic in-memory CAN bus for tests and simulation, on every operating system. |
